review: I purchased the Natural Black version of the box. This is not painted wood and not resin. This is constructed from small marble slabs and assembled into the final shape. The box itself is gorgeous. The marble construction is hefty and will definitely keep the interior tissue box in place when extracting a tissue. Even when the tissue box is near empty. Rubber feet on the bottom opening of the box ensure that it stays in place and does not slide upon the surface on which it is resting. Most importantly, it fits U.S.-sized square facial tissue boxes. A number of other stone-based boxes on Amazon are just a quarter- to half-inch too short to properly fit standard tissue boxes (e.g. Kleenex and Kirkland brand boxes). This one fits perfectly. Will be buying a few more of these for other locations throughout my home.
